title: Banff Premium Ski Rental Including Delivery
includes: In room fitting at your requested time (usually done the night before your first day of skiing)
Premium Skis, poles and boot rental
Guaranteed to skip the long lines
Delivered and picked up at your hotel
Helmets are not included in the price. They are available to purchase separately.
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Adults are considered 13 years or older
Children must be accompanied by an adult
policies: Delivery service is only for those directly in the Banff area
Please note: Rental gear is not guaranteed until re-confirmed. You MUST re-confirm your reservation NO LATER than 48 hours prior to your desired rental date.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Don't waste another minute waiting in line at the rental shops. Instead, place your order for skis, snowboards, boots and helmets before you arrive and have a custom fitting in your hotel room, condo or vacation home. If you need any support during your trip, a quick phone call will provide you assistance. Returns are just as convenient and easy as delivery.  When you are finished with your rentals, pickup is provided from your lodging.
